span.p:
Red LED is NOT controlled here.
updateLEDs() in main loop blinks it
whenever millis() − last_injection_ms < 500 ms

span.p:
calculatePulseWidth(rpm, tps, iat, et)
Look up base value from map 10×4
(bilinear interpolation, units = 100 µs)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Apply IAT correction (Q8.8 multiply)
pw = base_pw × iat_correction[iat] >> 8

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Apply ET correction (Q8.8 multiply)
pw = pw × et_correction[et] >> 8
Clamp to MAX_PULSE_US (25 000 µs)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Add accelerator pump extra:
accel = getAccelPumpExtra()
pw = min(pw + accel, 25 000 µs)

span.p:
fireInjector(pw):
last_pulse_width_us = pw
ticks = pw × 2 (0.5 µs/tick)
INJECTOR_ON() — D4 HIGH
last_injection_ms = millis()
OCR1A = TCNT1 + ticks
enable OCIE1A (compare-A interrupt)
